anya (docs): Dropping a short PR with focused examples for rate limits, quotas, and usage panels. Draft: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/2622 :wave:

sam (eng-platform): Quick checks: 1) use new header X-RW-Usage in all snippets; 2) pick a canonical aggregation for billing examples (hourly preferred).

anya (docs): Will do both — hourly as canonical and a 1m ops variant. I'll update headers to X-RW-Usage and add a mapping note for X-Usage-Tokens for older SDKs.

mike (product): Add a one-liner about "visible allocation = committed tier + burst credits" so customers understand the dashboard number.

lia (devex): Tiny SDK suggestion: include a minimal JS fetch that parses body.series[].points so folks see ordering. Example OK to be terse.

anya (docs): Adding this under SDK snippets:

```
// hourly aggregation
const r = await fetch('/v1/usage?from=-1h&group_by=1h',{  headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${process.env.RW_KEY}`,'X-RW-Usage':'project=acme,env=prod'}});
const b = await r.json();
console.log(b.series[0].points.map(p=>p.value));
```

sam (eng-platform): Also include a Grafana permalink (panel id 72 for rate/usage overview) and a brief troubleshooting tip: if totals double during canary -> stable flips, check routing headers and meter_key uniqueness.

anya (docs): Added panel link and troubleshooting callout. Also included a short paragraph: "Fallback routing can change per-model meter attribution; use per-route snapshots to reconcile."

mike (product): Good. After CI, tag me and Sam for review. Consider a follow-up issue to add a prompt set for token-churn tests (Optimize).

anya (docs): Pushed updates and CI passed. Tagging reviewers @sam (eng-platform) @mike (product). :rocket:
